verses.ar: طَلَعَ الْبَدْرُ عَلَيْنَا ۞ مِنْ ثَنِيَّاتِ الْوَدَاعْ
verses.tr: Ṭalaʿa l-badru ʿalaynā, min thanīyāti l-wadāʿ.
verses.en: The full moon has risen upon us, from the valley of Wada.

verses.ar: وَجَبَ الشُّكْرُ عَلَيْنَا ۞ مَا دَعَا لِلَّهِ دَاعْ
verses.tr: Wajaba sh-shukru ʿalaynā, mā daʿā li-Llāhi dāʿ.
verses.en: Gratitude is incumbent upon us, whenever one calls to Allah.

verses.ar: أَيُّهَا الْمَبْعُوثُ فِينَا ۞ جِئْتَ بِالْأَمْرِ الْمُطَاعْ
verses.tr: Ayyuha l-mabʿūthu fīnā, ji'ta bi-l-amri l-muṭāʿ.
verses.en: O you who have been sent among us, you came with the command to be obeyed.

verses.ar: جِئْتَ شَرَفْتَ الْمَدِينَةَ ۞ مَرْحَبًا يَا خَيْرَ دَاعْ
verses.tr: Ji'ta sharrafta l-Madīnah, marḥaban yā khayra dāʿ.
verses.en: You came and honoured Madinah, welcome, O noblest caller to Allah!

verses.ar: طَلَعَ النُّورُ الْمُبِينُ ۞ نُورُ خَيْرِ الْمُرْسَلِينْ
verses.tr: Ṭalaʿa n-nūru l-mubīnu, nūru khayri l-mursalīn.
verses.en: The clear light has risen, the light of the best of messengers.

verses.ar: نُورُ أَمْنٍ وَسَلَامٍ ۞ نُورُ حَقٍّ وَيَقِينْ
verses.tr: Nūru amnin wa-salāmin, nūru ḥaqqin wa-yaqīn.
verses.en: A light of safety and peace, a light of truth and certainty.

verses.ar: سَاقَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ۞ رَحْمَةً لِلْعَالَمِينْ
verses.tr: Sāqahu Llāhu taʿālā, raḥmatan li-l-ʿālamīn.
verses.en: Allah Most High sent him, a mercy to all the worlds.

verses.ar: فَعَلَى الْبَرِّ شُعَاعٌ ۞ وَعَلَى الْبَحْرِ شُعَاعْ
verses.tr: Fa-ʿalā l-barri shuʿā'un, wa-ʿalā l-baḥri shuʿā.
verses.en: Its radiance shines upon the land, and upon the sea.

verses.ar: مَرْحَبًا يَا مُصْطَفَانَا ۞ نُورُكَ الْغَالِي أَضَاءْ
verses.tr: Marḥaban yā Muṣṭafānā, nūruka l-ghālī aḍā'.
verses.en: Welcome, O our Chosen One, your precious light has shone forth.

verses.ar: رُغْمَ أَنْفِ الْمُلْحِدِينَ ۞ فَيْضُهُ عَمَّ الْبِقَاعْ
verses.tr: Rughma anfi l-mulḥidīna, fayḍuhu ʿamma l-biqāʿ.
verses.en: Despite the deniers, his overflowing grace has spread across the lands.

verses.ar: أَشْرَقَتْ شَمْسُ الْكَمَالِ ۞ بِكَ يَا بَاهِي الْجَمَالْ
verses.tr: Ashraqat shamsu l-kamāli, bika yā bāhī l-jamāl.
verses.en: The sun of perfection has risen through you, O radiant in beauty.

verses.ar: جَلَّ مَنْ سَوَّاكَ حَقًّا ۞ دَائِمًا لِلْخَيْرِ سَاعْ
verses.tr: Jalla man sawwāka ḥaqqan, dā'iman li-l-khayri sāʿ.
verses.en: Exalted is He who truly fashioned you, ever hastening you toward every good.

verses.ar: صَفْوَةُ الْبَارِي مُحَمَّدٌ ۞ دُرَّةٌ لِلْكَائِنَاتْ
verses.tr: Ṣafwatu l-Bārī Muḥammadun, durratun li-l-kā'ināt.
verses.en: Muhammad, the Elect of the Creator, a pearl among all creation.

verses.ar: مَدْحُهُ بَلْسَمُ رُوحِي ۞ وَلَهُ يَحْلُو السَّمَاعْ
verses.tr: Madḥuhu balsamu rūḥī, wa-lahu yaḥlū s-samāʿ.
verses.en: His praise is balm to my soul, and listening to it is sweet indeed.

verses.ar: يَا خِتَامَ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ ۞ يَا إِمَامَ الْأَوْلِيَاءْ
verses.tr: Yā khitāma l-anbiyā'i, yā imāma l-awliyā.
verses.en: O Seal of the Prophets! O Leader of the Saints!

verses.ar: رَحْمَةً أُرْسِلْتَ طَهَ ۞ مُنْقِذًا بَعْدَ الضَّيَاعْ
verses.tr: Raḥmatan ursilta Ṭāhā, munqiẓan baʿda ḍ-ḍayāʿ.
verses.en: You were sent as mercy, O Taha, a saviour after mankind had gone astray.

verses.ar: صَلَوَاتُ اللَّهِ تُهْدَى ۞ لَكَ مِنَّا وَالسَّلَامْ
verses.tr: Ṣalawātu Llāhi tuhdā, laka minnā wa-s-salām.
verses.en: Blessings of Allah are sent to you, and peace from all of us.

verses.ar: يَا أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ يَا مَنْ ۞ أَمْرُهُ دَوْمًا مُطَاعْ
verses.tr: Yā Abā l-Qāsimi yā man, amruhu dawman muṭāʿ.
verses.en: O Aba al-Qasim, O you whose word is ever obeyed.

verses.ar: بَيْنَ كَتْفَهِ عَلَامَةٌ ۞ خَاتِمُ الرُّسْلِ الْكِرَامْ
verses.tr: Bayna katfahi ʿalāmah, khātimu r-rusli l-kirām.
verses.en: Between his shoulder blades is a mark, the seal of all the noble messengers.

verses.ar: أَشْرَقَ الْبَدْرُ عَلَيْنَا ۞ وَاخْتَفَى بَدْرُ التَّمَامْ
verses.tr: Ashraqa l-badru ʿalaynā, wa-khtafā badru t-tamām.
verses.en: The full moon has risen upon us, and all other full moons have faded.

verses.ar: مِثْلُ حُسْنِكَ مَا رَأَيْنَا ۞ فِي الْعِرَاقَيْنِ وَشَامْ
verses.tr: Mithla ḥusnika mā ra'aynā, fī l-ʿIrāqayni wa-Shām.
verses.en: We have never seen beauty like yours, not in Iraq, nor in the Levant.

verses.ar: رَبِّ فَاجْعَلْ مُجْتَمَعْنَا ۞ غَايَتُهْ حُسْنُ الْخِتَامْ
verses.tr: Rabbi fajʿal mujtamaʿnā, ghāyatuh ḥusnu l-khitām.
verses.en: My Lord, make the goal of our gathering a beautiful ending.

verses.ar: وَأَعْطِنَا مَا قَدْ سَأَلْنَا ۞ مِنْ عَطَايَاكَ الْجِسَامْ
verses.tr: Wa-aʿṭinā mā qad sa'alnā, min ʿaṭāyāka l-jisām.
verses.en: And grant us what we have asked for, from Your vast, abundant gifts.

verses.ar: وَأَكْرِمِ الْأَرْوَاحَ مِنَّا ۞ بِاللِّقَاءْ خَيْرِ الْأَنَامْ
verses.tr: Wa-akrimi l-arwāḥa minnā, bi-l-liqā' khayri l-anām.
verses.en: And honour our souls by granting us, a meeting with the Best of Creation.

verses.ar: وَابْلِغِ الْمُخْتَارَ عَنَّا ۞ مِنْ صَلَاةٍ وَسَلَامْ
verses.tr: Wa-blighi l-mukhtāra ʿannā, min ṣalātin wa-salām.
verses.en: And convey from us to the Chosen One our prayers and peace.
